I read the whole file and looked for repeated nontrivial reasoning. I did not open the imported Krasner file or search Mathlib for existing lemmas.

The only repetition is in `exists_pos_adjoin_rootSet_eq_of_separable_normalized`. The splitting of `X * C X.leadingCoeff⁻¹` is proved twice, once for `f` and once for `g`, with the same `simpa [Polynomial.map_mul] using ... .mul (Splits.C ..)`. The rootSet identities `hfroots` and `hgroots` are likewise proved twice, with the same `rw [mul_comm, rootSet, aroots_C_mul _ h, rootSet]`. Each repeat is a one- or two-line routine rewrite or wrapper over existing API. A shared lemma would save little and would add a declaration. The rubric excludes short calculations, routine unfolding and thin wrappers, so I do not count this as a finding.

The long epsilon-delta proof in `exists_pos_norm_mul_leadingCoeff_inv_coeff_sub_lt` appears only once. The final theorem `exists_pos_adjoin_rootSet_eq_of_separable` just composes the two earlier results. I found no other repeated nontrivial machinery.
